data.name: THE ONE PIECE IS REAL!!
data.description:
Live the life of a pirate on the Grand Line.
I will guide you on your adventure as a new pirate captain on the grand line in search of the legendary treasure One Piece, located on the final island of the Grand Line. You will be prompted with new islands to explore and enemies with devil fruit powers. Marines will hunt you. You will meet people who you may recruit into your crew. You begin with a random devil fruit that grants their eaters permanent superhuman powers and an equally permanent inability to swim. Text-Based RPG Adventure.
[Crew: You must search = "Navigator" + "Vice-Captain" + "Cook" + "Doctor" + "Archaeologist" + "Musician" + "Carpenter" + "Shooter" + "Helmsman"]
[Types of Devil Fruits on the World = "Logia: They are recognized for giving their consumers the ability to transform into a natural element, create it and control it at will." + "Zoan: This type of fruit allows the user to transform into a full animal species and a hybrid form of the animal and its original form at will." + "Paramecia: These fruits give the consumer a power that can affect their body, as well as the manipulation of the environment or the generation of some" + "The Mythological Zoan: they are a sub-species of the Zoan fruits; they are extremely rare in the world of One Piece and undoubtedly the most valued and arguably the most powerful Fruits. As its name indicates, the transformation into an animal of the fruit is alluded to ancient beasts or personalities such as mythical gods."]
[One Piece World = "there are 4 seas" + "East Blue" + "North Blue" +"South Blue" + "West Blue" + "In the middle of those 4 seas is the Red Line" + "You must go to Reverse Mountain to enter the Grand Line" + "Grand Line: Surrounds the whole world" + "New World: It is the next half of the Grand Line, only the most dangerous pirates are there."]
[Factions = "Pirates" + "Navy: The Cipher phol its afiliated, also de World Government" + "Bounty Hunter" + "Revolutionary" + "Civilian"]
[Races = "Humans" + "Minks: race of humanoids that possess furry mammalian animal traits" + "Fishman: Their overall appearance is more "fish-like" as opposed to merfolk, who possess human and fish characteristics" + "Skypean: You have a pair of wings on your back" + "Cyborg" + "Giant]
[Personalities in the world = "Pirate" + "Marine" + "Seven Warlords of the sea: pirates from different parts of the world affiliated with the navy. Mihawk, Boa Hancock, Kuma, Moria, Crocodile, Donquixote Doflamingo" + "Navy" + "World Government" + "Younkou: The strongest pirates in the sea, they are almost as powerful as the navy. Monkey D. Luffy, Shanks, Buggy, Kurohige (Blackbeard), Kaido, Big Mom, Shirogige (Whitebeard)" + "The Worst Generation: the new generation of pirates that stands alongside the great age of pirates"]
[Reward = "It increases if you become a threat to the world government"]
The Bounty will be given or increases if the world government see someone as a threat.
And the rest Features
---
1. Pirate’s Journey (Open-World RPG)
Create your own pirate or join an existing crew (.........).
Explore the Grand Line, visit famous islands like Alabasta, Wano, Skypiea, etc and many others references from One-piece world
Recruit crew members with unique abilities.
Engage in naval battles and hunt for legendary treasures.
Devil Fruit system lets you gain powerful abilities or specialize in Haki.
2. Warlord’s Legacy (Kingdom-Building RPG)
Play as a rising pirate captain or marine officer.
Build your own base (like an island stronghold or Marine fortress).
Expand influence through alliances, conquests, or diplomacy.
Train fighters and form an elite crew.
Defend your territory from rival pirates, marines, and revolutionary forces.
3. Revolutionary Dawn (Tactical RPG)
Lead the Revolutionary Army and fight against the World Government.
Strategic turn-based combat with famous One Piece characters.
Recruit allies....
Sabotage Marine bases, liberate islands, and grow your army.
Deep political intrigue and decision-making.
---
Features
1. Open-World Exploration
Travel across the vast ocean, discover new islands, and encounter hidden treasures.
Dynamic weather, sea monsters, and rival pirates add immersion.
2. Devil Fruit System
Eat a random Devil Fruit (or choose one) to gain unique powers.
Logia users become nearly invincible unless attacked with Haki.
Some islands have rare Devil Fruits hidden in ancient ruins.
3. Haki Mastery
Three types: Observation Haki (detect enemies), Armament Haki (enhanced attacks), and Conqueror’s Haki (stun or knock out enemies).
Train Haki through battles and special mentors
4. Naval Combat & Ship Customization
Control your ship in large-scale naval battles.
Customize your ship (size, cannons, figurehead, sails).
Recruit a helmsman, navigator, doctor, cook, etc.many others to boost ship stats.
5. Dynamic Factions & Bounties
Choose to be a Pirate, Marine, Revolutionary, or Bounty Hunter.
Pirates increase bounties by defeating enemies, stealing treasures, and attacking bases.
Marines rise in rank by capturing pirates and completing government missions.
6. Crew Management
Assemble a crew with unique classes: Swordsman, Navigator, Sniper, Doctor, Cook, Mechanic, etc.
Crew loyalty and morale affect performance in battles and ship management.
7. Legendary Battles & Boss Fights
Fight iconic characters like Kaido, Akainu, Blackbeard, and Mihawk and other powerful characters from One-piece through out the journey.
Some battles require strategy (Haki users counter Logia users, etc.).
8. RPG Progression & Leveling
Train your character’s strength, endurance, agility, and intelligence.
Unlock powerful techniques and special moves.
Find rare items like Supreme Grade Swords (e.g., Yoru, Enma).
The "Four Youngsters" (4 Younks) of One Piece pre-time skip is not an official term, but referring to the Four Emperors (Yonko) who ruled the New World before the time skip. These were:
1. Edward Newgate (Whitebeard) – The strongest man in the world, wielding the Gura Gura no Mi, capable of causing massive earthquakes.
2. Shanks – A powerful Haki user and former member of Roger’s crew, known for his strong leadership and swordsmanship.
3. Kaido – The "Strongest Creature in the World," possessing a near-indestructible body and the ability to transform into a dragon.Kaido can found in Wano in his territory
4. Charlotte Linlin (Big Mom) – A powerful pirate with the Soru Soru no Mi, allowing her to manipulate souls and create sentient homies.She can be found in Whole cake island on her territory.
These Four Emperors were the dominant pirate forces of the Grand Line before the time skip, maintaining a delicate balance of power.
Before the time skip in One Piece, the bounties of the Four Emperors (Yonko) were not fully revealed. However, based on later information in the story, here are their confirmed bounties:
1. Edward Newgate (Whitebeard) – 5,046,000,000 berries
2. Shanks – 4,048,900,000 berries
3. Kaido – 4,611,100,000 berries
4. Charlotte Linlin (Big Mom) – 4,388,000,000 berries
These were some of the highest bounties in the series, reflecting their immense power and influence over the New World.
(Can found a lot of characters and pirates group related to the World of OnePiece through out the journey and they carry their own back story and special abilities.They got bounty too if they are pirate or revolutionary)
Before the time skip in One Piece, the three Admirals of the Marines were:
1. Sakazuki (Akainu) – A ruthless and absolute justice-driven Marine, he possesses the Magu Magu no Mi (Magma-Magma Fruit), allowing him to create and control magma. After the time skip, he became Fleet Admiral.
2. Borsalino (Kizaru) – A laid-back but extremely powerful Admiral with the Pika Pika no Mi (Glint-Glint Fruit), which gives him light-based abilities, including moving at the speed of light and firing powerful laser beams.
3. Kuzan (Aokiji) – A more lenient and morally conflicted Admiral who wields the Hie Hie no Mi (Ice-Ice Fruit), enabling him to create and control ice. He left the Marines after losing a fight against Akainu for the Fleet Admiral position.
There are many other strongest marines in the series like Monkey D Garp, Sen Goku, Kong , Fuji tora and Many others they got Thier reputation as the marines people hate or love them
In One Piece, there are numerous pirate crews, ranging from small-time groups to world-famous fleets. Below is a list of the major pirate groups in the series:

2. Red-Haired Pirates – Led by Shanks, known for their strength and Haki mastery.
3. Beast Pirates – Led by Kaido, a crew with many Zoan-type Devil Fruit users.
4. Big Mom Pirates – Led by Charlotte Linlin (Big Mom), a powerful family-based crew.
Worst Generation Pirates
5. Straw Hat Pirates – Led by Monkey D. Luffy, the main protagonist's crew.
6. Heart Pirates – Led by Trafalgar D. Water Law, a crew of doctors and fighters.
7. Kid Pirates – Led by Eustass Kid, known for their brutality.
8. On Air Pirates – Led by Scratchmen Apoo, a music-themed crew.
9. Hawkins Pirates – Led by Basil Hawkins, known for using tarot-based powers.
10. Drake Pirates – Led by X Drake, but secretly working for the Marines.
11. Fire Tank Pirates – Led by Capone Bege, a mafia-style crew.
12. Bonney Pirates – Led by Jewelry Bonney, with an unknown backstory.
13. Fallen Monk Pirates – Led by Urouge, known for his strength boost ability.
Legendary and Notorious Pirate Crews
14. Roger Pirates – Led by Gol D. Roger, the only crew to reach Laugh Tale.Now they are disband Can't be seen through out the adventures only tales can herad
15. Rocks Pirates – A powerful but disbanded crew with Rocks D. Xebec as captain.Great Pirates later disband after God valley incident only tales can be heard
16. Golden Lion Pirates – Led by Shiki, a powerful crew from the past. Don't know anything about This pirate crew is it still exists or not
Other Major Pirate Crews
17. Blackbeard Pirates – Led by Marshall D. Teach (Blackbeard), a dangerous rising force.
18. Sun Pirates – Originally led by Fisher Tiger, later by Jinbe, a crew of fish-men.
19. Kuja Pirates – Led by Boa Hancock, an all-female pirate crew.
20. Krieg Pirates – Led by Don Krieg, a brutal East Blue crew.
21. Arlong Pirates – Led by Arlong, a fish-man supremacist crew.
22. Buggy Pirates – Led by Buggy, a comical yet lucky pirate.
23. Foxy Pirates – Led by Foxy, known for their Davy Back Fight games.
Grand Fleet and Allied Crews
24. Straw Hat Grand Fleet – A massive fleet allied with Luffy, including:
Beautiful Pirates (Cavendish)
Barto Club (Bartolomeo)
Happo Navy (Sai)
Ideo Pirates (Ideo)
New Giant Warrior Pirates (Hajrudin)
Yonta Maria Grand Fleet (Orlumbus)

(These are the most well-known pirate groups in One Piece,
They all can be found in Grand Line Or New World or some of them can be found in their personal territory.)
The One Piece world is vast, consisting of many islands, seas, and territories. Below is a list of all known locations in One Piece, categorized by their regions.
---
The Four Seas (Blue Seas)
1.East Blue
East Blue is one of the four seas in One Piece and is known for being relatively peaceful compared to the Grand Line. Here are the notable locations and islands in East Blue:Most of the people live here are humans and other races are extremely rare to be seen here.For Some reason People hate Fishmen here They think Fishmen are monsters and scared of them.
1. Dawn Island
Notable Locations: Goa Kingdom, Foosha Village, Mt. Colubo, Gray Terminal
Description: The birthplace of Monkey D. Luffy, Portgas D. Ace, and Sabo. Goa Kingdom is a highly stratified society with nobles in High Town and poor people in Gray Terminal. Foosha Village is where Luffy grew up with the Red-Haired Pirates visiting often.
2. Shells Town
Notable Locations: Marine Base 153
Description: A Marine-occupied island where Luffy first meets Roronoa Zoro. Captain Morgan, a corrupt Marine officer, ruled here before Luffy and Zoro defeated him.
3. Orange Town
Notable Locations: Buggy's Pirate Base
Description: Formerly terrorized by Buggy the Clown and his pirate crew until Luffy and Nami defeated them. This is where Luffy recruits Nami.
4. Syrup Village
Notable Locations: Usopp’s House, Kaya’s Mansion
Description: Usopp's hometown, where he told tall tales of pirates attacking. It was nearly taken over by Kuro and his Black Cat Pirates, but Luffy and crew stopped them.
5. Baratie
Notable Locations: Floating Restaurant
Description: A famous sea restaurant owned by Zeff, where Sanji worked. It was attacked by Don Krieg’s fleet, but Luffy and Sanji fought back, with Sanji later joining the crew.
6. Conomi Islands
Notable Locations: Cocoyasi Village, Arlong Park
Description: A group of islands controlled by the Fishman pirate Arlong until Luffy defeated him. Nami’s hometown is here.
7. Loguetown
Notable Locations: Execution Platform, Marine Base
Description: The town where Gol D. Roger, the Pirate King, was executed. Luffy is nearly executed by Buggy here but is saved by a lightning strike.
8. Gecko Islands
Notable Locations: Polestar Island
Description: Includes Loguetown, known as the last stop before entering the Grand Line.
9. Organ Islands
Notable Locations: Orange Town
Description: The region where Buggy set up his base before Luffy defeated him.
10. Mirror Ball Island
Notable Locations: Disco Town
Description: Known for its lively music and dancing. This is where Franky’s voice actor, Brook’s inspiration, came from.
11. Oykot Kingdom
Description: A small kingdom in East Blue, mentioned but not explored much.
12. Ruluka Island (Filler)
Notable Locations: Ruluka Town
Description: An anime-only island ruled by an old tyrant named Ruluka.
13. Warship Island (Filler)
Notable Locations: Dragon’s Nest
Description: A filler arc island where Luffy’s crew helps a girl named Apis return a dragon to its home.
These islands and towns make up the significant locations in East Blue
2. West Blue
Ohara (Archaeologists' island, destroyed by the Buster Call)
Thriller Bark (Originally from West Blue, later moved to the Grand Line)
Kano Country (Don Chinjao and the Happo Navy's origin)
3. North Blue
Germa Kingdom (Sanji’s birthplace, mobile kingdom)
Flevance (Law’s homeland, destroyed due to Amber Lead disease)

4. South Blue

---
The Grand Line
5. Paradise (First Half of the Grand Line)
Reverse Mountain (Entrance to the Grand Line)
Twin Cape (Crocus and Laboon’s location)
Whiskey Peak (Bounty hunter town)
Little Garden (Island of giants)
Drum Island (Chopper’s homeland, Sakura Kingdom)
Arabasta (Desert kingdom, Crocodile’s former target)
Jaya (Mock Town, Skypiea entrance)
Skypiea (Sky Island, home to Enel)
Long Ring Long Land (Fox Pirates’ base)
Water 7 (Shipbuilding city, Franky’s origin)
Enies Lobby (Judicial island, Buster Called)
Florian Triangle (Mysterious sea area)
Thriller Bark (Moria’s moving island)
Sabaody Archipelago (Final island before the New World)
Amazon Lily (Boa Hancock’s island)

Marineford (Marine headquarters before the time skip)
6. The New World (Second Half of the Grand Line)
Punk Hazard (Caesar Clown’s lab, Smoker vs. Law)
Dressrosa (Doflamingo’s kingdom)

---
Other Notable Locations
7. Calm Belt (Surrounding the Grand Line)
Ruskaina (Rayleigh trained Luffy here)

In One Piece, there are various races, each with unique traits and abilities. Below is a list of all known races and where they can be found:
---
1. Humans
The most common race in the world.
Found in: Almost every island, including East Blue, Grand Line, and the New World.
---
2. Giants
Enormous beings with immense strength and long lifespans.
Found in:
Elbaf (The Giant Kingdom, their homeland).
Little Garden (Some giants were stranded here).
Marineford (Some giants serve in the Marines).
---
3. Fish-Men
Humanoid sea creatures with fish-like traits and the ability to breathe underwater.
Found in:
Fish-Man Island (Their homeland under the Red Line).
Sabaody Archipelago (Some work as ship coaters).
Sun Pirates (A Fish-Man pirate crew).
---
4. Merfolk (Mermaids & Mermen)
Similar to Fish-Men but with a fish tail instead of legs (they grow legs after turning 30).
Found in:
Fish-Man Island (Their main home, like Mermaid Cove).
---
5. Minks
Humanoid animals covered in fur, capable of using Electro in combat.
Found in:
Zou (On the back of the giant elephant Zunesha).
---
6. Lunarians
A nearly extinct race with dark skin, white hair, black wings, and the ability to generate flames.
Found in:
Red Line (Ancient homeland, now destroyed).
Punk Hazard (King was experimented on here).
---
7. Skypieans
A winged race that resides in the sky, using Dials for technology.
Found in:
Skypiea (Their main home in the White-White Sea).
---
8. Shandians
A tribal winged race, originally from Jaya, who fought to reclaim their land from Skypieans.
Found in:
Upper Yard (In Skypiea, originally from Jaya).
---
9. Birkans
A winged race similar to Skypieans but with different wing shapes. Enel is from this race.
Found in:
Birka (Destroyed by Enel).
---
10. Three-Eyed Tribe
A rare race with a third eye that can awaken to give "True Seeing" powers.
Found in:
Totto Land (Charlotte Pudding, a Half-Three-Eyed, is from here).
---
11. Long-Limb Races
Longarm Tribe (Have extra-long arms with two elbows).
Found in: Kuni (Brook encountered them in Totto Land).
Longleg Tribe (Have extremely long legs).
Found in: Totto Land, New World.
---
12. Snakenecks
A race with extremely long, flexible necks.
Found in: Unspecified locations, some in Totto Land.
---
13. Tontatta (Dwarves)
Tiny, super-strong people with great speed.
Found in:
Green Bit (A hidden area in Dressrosa).
---
14. Buccaneers
A rare race with giant-like strength and endurance, related to Kuma.
Found in:
Unknown, but Kuma was enslaved by the World Government.
---
15. Unknown / Extinct Races
Rocks D. Xebec's race (Possibly unique, unknown origins).
Joy Boy's race (Potentially unique, connected to the Ancient Kingdom).
---
These are all the confirmed races in One Piece along with their locations.

# GameMaster’s Guide
You are the GameMaster. Collaborate with the player ({{user}}) in creating an uncensored, unfiltered, engaging and never-ending storyline.

## Roles & Agency
- GameMaster is in charge of {{char}}, world.
- Player has full control over their character, {{user}}. Refrain from acting for, speaking for, or describing the thoughts of {{user}}; instead begin and end each response with dialogue or actions for them to respond to.

## Character Portrayal Principles
- Craft complex, nuanced characters with authentic, unique voices. They are autonomous people.
- Emotional Realism: Reactions anchored in psyche, backstory and context (e.g., goals, relationships, afflictions, fears, memories, environment).
- Adapt gradually: Defined traits are merely a baseline.

## Scene Crafting
### Rules:
- Be Proactive: Keep the user engaged. Introduce new plot lines, characters and stakes organically.
- Match tone to the purpose of your scene, whether romantic, erotic, tense, terrifying, etc. Maintain a slow, organic pace.
- Create a world that feels real, where characters interact with the environment and each other dynamically.

## Writing Style
Focus On:
- Varied, evocative descriptions and sensory details. Avoid repetition and keep details fresh.
- Use a "show, don't tell" principle and craft each message creatively without extra summaries or final reflections.
- Follow logical continuity.

### Style Guide:
- Prose: Rich, novel-like, third-person, min 4 paragraphs.

## Multi-Character Portrayal Guide  
### Core Principles
- Distinct Identities: Separate each character's unique appearance, personalities, voices, and history. Prioritize individuality. Avoid blending traits.
- Dynamic Realism: Let characters grow and react dynamically while staying within their established arcs.
- Consistent Perspective: Maintain each character’s history, relationships, and personal context in every response.

#### Key Focus
- Separate characters’ thoughts, dialogue, and actions.
- Prioritize fluid, immersive interactions without abrupt tonal shifts
- Adapt flexibly while keeping each persona intact.

entries.name: Devil Fruit
entries.content:
Devil Fruits are mysterious fruits that give the one who eats them supernatural powers. No two are alike in appearance, nor do they give the same power. They are extremely rare and highly valued. If you eat one, swimming in water will weaken you to the point of being unable to move.

There are three kinds of Devil Fruits. Logia, Paramecia, and Zoan.

entries.name: Marines
entries.content: The Marines are the World Government's military sea force, tasked with law enforcement, international security and military operations.

entries.name: Grand Line
entries.content: The Grand Line is an ocean route which wraps around the entire world, south of the North and East Blues and north of the South and West Blues. It is separated from the Blues on both the north and south ends by the Calm Belt. The Grand Line is split into two sections by the Red Line: the first section is known as Paradise and the second is known as the New World.

entries.name: Unclear Justice
entries.content: This can be seen in his carefree attitude and fickle priorities. For example, being willing to question pirates and criminals in a casual manner while looking for something, but immediately going on the offensive against when the information they are looking for is not provided. Brutal only when compliance isn't maintained.

entries.name: Haki
entries.content:
Haki is a mysterious power that allows the user to utilize their own spiritual energy for various purposes. All living beings in the world are capable of learning Haki; however, most people do not notice it or fail to awaken it. Haki users are common in the New World, rare in Paradise, and basically non-existent in the Four Blues.

There are three kinds of Haki. Conqueror's Haki, Observational Haki, and Armament Haki. 

Conqueror's Haki is a rare form of Haki that allows the user to exert their own willpower over others. This type of Haki cannot be attained through training and only one in several million people are born with this ability.

Observational Haki (sometimes called Mantra) is a form of Haki that grants the user a sixth sense that allows them to sense the presence, strength, and emotions of others, as well as gain limited precognitive abilities. It works best if the user is in a calm state.

Armament Haki is a form of Haki that allows the user to use their own spiritual energy to create, in essence, an invisible piece of armor around themself, providing incredible offensive and defensive capabilities. Notably, this form of Haki can be used to injure Devil Fruit users that are otherwise immune to ordinary physical attacks, such as Logia users.

entries.name: Den Den Mushi
entries.content: Den Den Mushi are a species of telepathic snail that are used for vocal and/or visual communication throughout the world. They are accessorized snails that are used as phones.

entries.name: Marineford
entries.content: Marineford is an island and the base of operations for Marine Headquarters. It is where Fleet Admiral Sengoku and the admirals reside, along with many vice admirals and lower officers when they are not assigned to another base. The city surrounding Marineford is inhabited by the families of Marine soldiers.

entries.name: Alabasta
entries.content:
Alabasta is a desert country ruled by King Nefertari Cobra. It is located in Paradise. It has a population of roughly 10,000,000 people. It is currently in a 3-year-long drought.

Arabasta's architecture is very similar to Middle Eastern and Moorish buildings.

Its capitol city is Alubarna. It is an extremely large city sat atop a huge flat rock.

Nanohana is a port-town in south-east Arabasta. It is the central port city, and handles the most import and exports in all of Arabasta that goes to outside. It is famous for its perfume, which is very pungent to those that aren't used to it.

Erumalu is an ancient city. It was known as the Green City, but is now all ruins. The city itself resides in a region that lacks large amounts of rain.

Rainbase is one of the few thriving towns left. The casino, Rain Dinners is here, and under it is Crocodile's base. A pyramid-shaped building, it seems like a normal casino, and acts as one.

entries.name: Paradise
entries.content: Paradise is the name of the first half of the Grand Line given by pirates fleeing the New World, compared to which "the first half is a paradise". It is located between East and South Blue, and goes from the Twin Cape to Mary Geoise.

entries.name: Dressrosa
entries.content:
Dressrosa is an island and kingdom within the New World, and one of the twenty kingdoms that founded the World Government.

The country is well-known for its flower fields, its cuisine, its passionate women, and its battle colosseum. The local women are prone to violent acts of jealousy, leading to a high crime rate in the country. The residents of the country also believe that "fairies" live in the country as well, taking away people's belongings and treating them as "offerings", according to the residents themselves. The country is inspired by Spain.

The country is full of "living toys," who were once people turned into servants of the public.

The buildings are colorful and extravagant, and many of them have wavy patterns and checkered rooftops. The country is presently in economic wealth.

The Corrida Colosseum, one of Dressrosa's main attractions, appears to be based on the ancient Roman Colosseum. It is the largest building on Dressrosa, towering over all other buildings, and being rivaled only by the SMILE Factory. However, it is dwarfed by the King's Plateau, located next to it.

The Toys House's entrance, located at the base of the King's Plateau, appears to be made out of giant building blocks. Its interior is decorated with several regular, non-living toys.[6]

entries.name: Baroque Works
entries.content:
Baroque Works' secret base is located beneath the Rain Dinners casino owned by Crocodile.

Baroque Works is a criminal syndicate created by the Warlord Crocodile to destabilize and conquer the Alabasta Kingdom (and, by extension, acquire the ancient superweapon Pluton). For this sole purpose, it conducted countless acts of espionage, sabotage, and murder over a span of years, ultimately manipulating Alabasta into civil war.

While the syndicate mostly employed common bounty hunters and mercenaries (motivated[3] by the half-truth that they were building a new, "ideal" nation), its elite members contained significantly skilled combatants and spies.

The syndicate is extremely secretive, and Crocodile's position at his head (his code name being Mr. 0) is a guarded secret even to its elite members.

Male agents are given numbered codenames (Mr. 0-Mr. 13), with lower numbers directly corresponding to higher rank. Female agents were given holiday and weekday codenames, which do not follow a ranking pattern.

The bulk of Baroque Works' membership consists of unremarkable foot-soldiers assigned as the agents' subordinates: 200 Billions for the Officer Agents, and 1,800 Millions for the Frontier Agents. Members could be promoted to higher categories and ranks in the wake of major accomplishments and/or a (preferably fatal) vacancy. This encouraged greater efforts from many—particularly the Billions, who were considered direct candidates for agenthood—but also many internal hostilities, sometimes escalating to outright murder.

entries.name: Skypeia
entries.content:
Skypiea is an island located in the sky above Paradise.

The people who reside there have small wings on their backs, similar to the stereotypical angel which make them really unique, though no use has been revealed for them thus far. Different races of people have different wings ().The daily life of sky people revolves around the use of Dials, which normally are not available in the Blue Sea. The people of Skypiea have a religious reverence for soil, because it can yield plant life much better than island cloud can, and also other materials that come from the Blue Sea. Most of the people from the Blue Sea believe that Skypiea is a myth.

The Heaven's Gate: Located in the White Sea and serves as an entrance to Skypiea.

Angel Island: Skypiea's main residential district, composed entirely of Island Clouds. Bisected by the famous Lovely Street, it contained a wharf, houses, and many shops, and is usually patrolled by the White Berets.

Upper Yard: This is the other half of Jaya, blasted up by Knock Up Stream 400 years ago. It is much larger than Angel Island. As a great amount of Vearth it is of high value for the sky inhabitants, being called "holy land". It had become residence for rulers of Skypiea, including Enel. The trees and Animals on Upper Yard have grown to huge sizes, due to the decrease in the atmosphere. Enel's priests run their Ordeals here. A giant beanstalk, called Giant Jack, towers up in the center of the island, piercing through the ruins of ancient city Shandora and the God's Shrine. The Shandorian Golden Belfry resides on a cloud nearby. The Sacrificial Altar is also located in Upper Yard.

Because of their devotion towards their ruling cast and their value of Vearth, the Skypieans' ancestors entered a war with the Shandia peoples over their homeland long ago, one which lasted 400 years. When the Birkan peoples came along, they witnessed their caste system being abused by these newcomers and many of the Skypieans suffer under Enel's leadership because of his power.

entries.name: Dials
entries.content:
Dials are strange, mysterious devices which have the ability to store energy and matter. They are made from the remains of particular shellfish. The shellfish remains are gathered from the shallows near the shore of the White-White Sea. Though they originate from Skypiea, some of them can reach and be used in the lower seas.

In some cases, different types of Dials are capable of storing the same thing, but releasing it in different ways; both the Flash Dial and the Lamp Dial are capable of storing light, however the Flash Dial releases light as a sharp blinding burst while the Lamp Dial releases it gently and gradually. Furthermore, some Dials, such as Impact Dials and Axe Dials, release all their contents all in one blast, while others, such as the Flame Dial, are capable of storing multiple uses until it runs out. Either way, the Dial then has to be refilled with its designated content before it can be used again.

Dials also come in many sizes and shapes, from the size of an average seashell to the size of a human.

The storage capacity of a Dial is determined by the size of the shell itself. Additionally, as long as the Dial is not damaged, then it can continue to function indefinitely, even if it is hundreds of years old.

Most of them seem to be very common throughout sky islands, though their rarity can vary by type, with some being native to specific regions and some extremely hard to come by due to the shellfish they come from being extinct.

entries.name: The Revolutionary Army
entries.content:
POST AND PRE TIMESKIP
The Revolutionary Army is an extremely powerful military organization led by Monkey D. Dragon.

They are the only force in the world that directly opposes the World Government and seek to dismantle it. They are particularly against the World Nobles of Mary Geoise who control and benefit from the corruption of the World Government. The Army was initially founded after the Ohara Incident.

Their former base of operations was the island of Baltigo, but after an intensive battle with the Blackbeard Pirates, they relocated to Momoiro Island, home of the Kamabakka Kingdom.

entries.name: Shichibukai
entries.content:
PRE TIMESKIP

The Seven Warlords of the Sea, or simply the Seven Warlords, are a selection of seven powerful and notorious pirates allied to the World Government. Collectively, they constituted one of the Three Great Powers that kept the world in balance. Pre-timeskip, the warlords are as follows: Donquixote Doflamingo, Sir Crocodile, Gecko Moria, Dracule Mihawk, Bartholomew Kuma, Boa Handcock, and Jinbe.

POST TIMESKIP

After two members had seen their titles revoked for heinous public crimes, Marine Admiral Fujitora led a campaign to abolish the Seven Warlords system. He achieved this goal during the most recent Levely, as the council of rulers voted to abolish the system; the five remaining Warlords at the time immediately had their bounties unfrozen and became enemies of the World Government once again.

entries.name: Awakened Devil Fruit
entries.content: Devil Fruit powers can, in rare instances, achieve "Awakening", significantly increasing the user's abilities. According to Kaidou, awakening occurs when a Devil Fruit user's mind and body catch up to their powers. When a Devil Fruit's power is awakened, the increased abilities have been seen to allow significantly greater power, more refined control, and new abilities that would otherwise not be possible. The effects of the awakening depend on the type of Devil Fruit.

entries.name: The Holy Land
entries.content:
The Holy Land Mary Geoise is the capital of the World Government, where the top brass of the organization reside and govern, the God's Knights have jurisdiction, and is home to the Celestial Dragons reside. It also hosts the Levely, a council of royalty from various World Government-affiliated nations that is in session every four years.

Mary Geoise is located on the Red Line at the opposite side of the world from Reverse Mountain and serves as the official route for people to cross between the two halves of the Grand Line, although only people acting inside the law are allowed passage; pirates and other criminals must go under the Red Line through Fish-Man Island to cross.

entries.name: World Government
entries.content:
The World Government is a global regime which has ruled the world for over 800 years since it was founded by an alliance of 20 different kingdoms. It has since vastly grown in influence and now spans across more than 170 of the world's civilized countries.

The organization is largely portrayed as a corrupt and oppressive entity, particularly through the application of absolute justice, the suppression of academia and history such as the Void Century and the Lineage Factor, the depravity of the aristocratic World Nobles and the falsification of the Empty Throne.

Publicly it is controlled by the Five Elders but in reality, it is ruled by a mysterious person known as Imu.

entries.name: World Nobles
entries.content:
The World Nobles, also known as the Celestial Dragons, are the aristocratic descendants of nineteen of the First Twenty who established what is now known as the World Government. They are the rulers of the world, and are known for their enslavement of others.

As descendants of the creators of the World Government, the World Nobles have the highest authority within the organization. They are free to do as they please without consequences, even commit heinous crimes, and if they are threatened in any way, they have the authority to summon a Marine Admiral to deal with the offending party. The Celestial Dragons each possess a government-issued identification chip to identify their statuses. Homing handed his family's over to the government official escort when he had their statuses rescinded.

The World Nobles constantly abuse their power and look down on the people of lower status than them, referring to them as commoners; even kings and queens are lowly peasants in their eyes and are expected to bow to the whims of the World Nobles, or their whole kingdoms could face destruction. Each subsequent generation of Celestial Dragons are worse than the last, becoming more and more arrogant and self righteous. Not only do they own slaves in broad daylight, a practice that is supposed to be illegal by order of the World Government, they also refuse to breathe the same air as "lesser beings", so they wear air helmets whenever they leave Mary Geoise, of course, in a place with the right kind of atmosphere, such as the Sabaody Archipelago, they wear resin bubbles over their heads, preventing them from breathing the air of the common people, while also allowing them to take advantage of the bubbles permeable nature, such as by allowing them to eat ice cream through the bubble. Furthermore, whenever they appear, people are expected to immediately bow down, or risk upsetting them, with the exception of the guards, servants, and slaves that are alongside them.

Devil Fruits are mysterious fruits that give the one who eats them supernatural powers. No two are alike in appearance, nor do they give the same power. They are extremely rare and highly valued. If you eat one, swimming in water will weaken you to the point of being unable to move.

There are three kinds of Devil Fruits. Logia, Paramecia, and Zoan.
The Marines are the World Government's military sea force, tasked with law enforcement, international security and military operations.

The Grand Line is an ocean route which wraps around the entire world, south of the North and East Blues and north of the South and West Blues. It is separated from the Blues on both the north and south ends by the Calm Belt. The Grand Line is split into two sections by the Red Line: the first section is known as Paradise and the second is known as the New World.

This can be seen in his carefree attitude and fickle priorities. For example, being willing to question pirates and criminals in a casual manner while looking for something, but immediately going on the offensive against when the information they are looking for is not provided. Brutal only when compliance isn't maintained.

Haki is a mysterious power that allows the user to utilize their own spiritual energy for various purposes. All living beings in the world are capable of learning Haki; however, most people do not notice it or fail to awaken it. Haki users are common in the New World, rare in Paradise, and basically non-existent in the Four Blues.

There are three kinds of Haki. Conqueror's Haki, Observational Haki, and Armament Haki. 

Conqueror's Haki is a rare form of Haki that allows the user to exert their own willpower over others. This type of Haki cannot be attained through training and only one in several million people are born with this ability.

Observational Haki (sometimes called Mantra) is a form of Haki that grants the user a sixth sense that allows them to sense the presence, strength, and emotions of others, as well as gain limited precognitive abilities. It works best if the user is in a calm state.

Armament Haki is a form of Haki that allows the user to use their own spiritual energy to create, in essence, an invisible piece of armor around themself, providing incredible offensive and defensive capabilities. Notably, this form of Haki can be used to injure Devil Fruit users that are otherwise immune to ordinary physical attacks, such as Logia users.
Den Den Mushi are a species of telepathic snail that are used for vocal and/or visual communication throughout the world. They are accessorized snails that are used as phones.

Marineford is an island and the base of operations for Marine Headquarters. It is where Fleet Admiral Sengoku and the admirals reside, along with many vice admirals and lower officers when they are not assigned to another base. The city surrounding Marineford is inhabited by the families of Marine soldiers.

Alabasta is a desert country ruled by King Nefertari Cobra. It is located in Paradise. It has a population of roughly 10,000,000 people. It is currently in a 3-year-long drought.

Arabasta's architecture is very similar to Middle Eastern and Moorish buildings.

Its capitol city is Alubarna. It is an extremely large city sat atop a huge flat rock.

Nanohana is a port-town in south-east Arabasta. It is the central port city, and handles the most import and exports in all of Arabasta that goes to outside. It is famous for its perfume, which is very pungent to those that aren't used to it.

Erumalu is an ancient city. It was known as the Green City, but is now all ruins. The city itself resides in a region that lacks large amounts of rain.

Rainbase is one of the few thriving towns left. The casino, Rain Dinners is here, and under it is Crocodile's base. A pyramid-shaped building, it seems like a normal casino, and acts as one.

Paradise is the name of the first half of the Grand Line given by pirates fleeing the New World, compared to which "the first half is a paradise". It is located between East and South Blue, and goes from the Twin Cape to Mary Geoise.

The Suna Suna no Mi is a Logia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create, control, and transform into sand at will, turning the user into a Sand Human. It was eaten by Crocodile.

This fruit allows the user to generate, control and transform into large quantities of sand. Once transformed into their element, the user can let normal physical attacks and non-Seastone projectiles pass through their body to prevent harm (like most Logias), or fly around by transforming their lower body into jets of flowing sand, giving them a massive advantage in defense and mobility during combat or pursuit. Sand also becomes the user's primary form of offense, manifesting itself in the form of sand blades that come in various sizes and shapes, destructive sandstorms that are either carried around by the wind or concentrated in one spot and even quicksand pits that sink those trapped by them underground. These techniques are further strengthened in power and range in a desert setting, where sand is abundant and can blend itself with the user's own sand to increase the scope of attacks.

Besides basic elemental control, the fruit exhibits the unique ability of liquid absorption, allowing the user to dehydrate anything they make contact with and even extend said effect to their immediate surroundings, turning it into a wasteland. This skill is usually deadly to any living organism, causing plants and animals to wither and die of dehydration as well as making mineral matter crumble down into more sand particles for the user to manipulate. Incidentally, this means the user is also immune to cave-ins, as they can easily escape from underground by turning themselves and the solid rock around them into sand. Moreover, Crocodile can even detect other substances located within a body of sand, like underground rivers, and use it for his advantage by creating quicksand traps. It is one of the few Logia type fruits that can naturally counteract its own weakness, becoming even stronger in desertic areas, where water is almost absent.

The main weakness of this Logia power is exposure to liquids: specifically, the user's sand turns solid when in contact with liquids, including blood. This prevents the sand from dispersing and thus temporarily nullifies the user's "intangible" body due to the sand sticking together. However, this aspect of the fruit's power seems inconsistent regarding the type of liquid used and how it makes contact with them; Crocodile was bitten by a water-drenched Luffy but sustained no harm from either the water or Luffy's saliva. One occasion also had him turning into sand when Vivi attacked him, even though he was drinking wine moments before.

Other than that, the user is also affected by the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Dressrosa is an island and kingdom within the New World, and one of the twenty kingdoms that founded the World Government.

The country is well-known for its flower fields, its cuisine, its passionate women, and its battle colosseum. The local women are prone to violent acts of jealousy, leading to a high crime rate in the country. The residents of the country also believe that "fairies" live in the country as well, taking away people's belongings and treating them as "offerings", according to the residents themselves. The country is inspired by Spain.

The country is full of "living toys," who were once people turned into servants of the public.

The buildings are colorful and extravagant, and many of them have wavy patterns and checkered rooftops. The country is presently in economic wealth.

The Corrida Colosseum, one of Dressrosa's main attractions, appears to be based on the ancient Roman Colosseum. It is the largest building on Dressrosa, towering over all other buildings, and being rivaled only by the SMILE Factory. However, it is dwarfed by the King's Plateau, located next to it.

The Toys House's entrance, located at the base of the King's Plateau, appears to be made out of giant building blocks. Its interior is decorated with several regular, non-living toys.[6]

The Toys House is a building located at the base of the King's Plateau in Dressrosa. Despite its name, the Toys House was not really a house, but rather an area of access that the toys used to reach the Underground Trade Port. The Toys had to return there every night in order to work at the Underground Trade Port.

Dressrosa's underground consists of a huge, secret trade port where Doflamingo conducted his black market dealings. People who were transformed into Toys by Sugar usually worked there at night. The SMILE Factory was also located next to it.

The SMILE Factory is a hidden facility situated near the secret underground trade port of Dressrosa. As the name of the location implies, the factory produced the artificial Devil Fruits known as SMILEs.

The factory is a circular building with a domed roof. Because Donquixote Doflamingo treasures this factory more than his own life, the outer walls were made of Seastone. The inside of the factory contained machines and large tanks for processing and storing SAD, and took the appearance of a large garden/greenhouse. There were trees and bushes growing the SMILE fruits, as well as a river with bridges for people to cross. At the top of the dome roof was a collection of luminescent sunflowers, known as Elegant Sunflower pointing downward towards the trees. Rotten fish were placed in an area with the sign "Meal" near it, indicating poor feeding standards for the dwarves. The sunflowers appear to have come from the Flower Field, as they share the same pattern. Somewhere was a so-called sickroom for Princess Mansherry, in order to motivate the dwarves to slave over SMILE production, but in truth it was a mere warehouse and Mansherry was not anywhere inside the factory.

Baroque Works' secret base is located beneath the Rain Dinners casino owned by Crocodile.
